column1: # *** THE TRINIDAD FOUNDING KINDRED, AND THE PRIEST WHO DREW IT. 9 October 2026. ***
# Work-list row 196 asked one question: is SOCORRO LERENA a sister of BERNABE? It was the last
# inference standing in the Trinidad work, and the 1897 birth act could not settle it.
# *** IT IS SETTLED, AND NOT BY INFERENCE. *** Three MARRIAGE EXPEDIENTES of the 1850s - read on
# 9 October 2026 - name the parents and grandparents of both of them, and the third one carries
# *** A KINSHIP DIAGRAM THE CURA VICARIO DREW WITH HIS OWN HAND. ***
# *** AND THE COLLECTION WAS NOT WHAT THIS ARCHIVE SAID IT WAS. *** On 8 October it published that
# the Arquidiocesis de Montevideo Marriage Dispensation Records are the Vicar General's summary
# ledger, one sentence per couple, naming no parents - and that the informaciones matrimoniales
# are a separate series this archive had not reached. *** THE LEDGER FINDING WAS TRUE OF THE
# VOLUMES THEN READ, WHICH WERE ALL 1885-1913. *** The volumes of the 1850s in the same collection
# are *** FULL EXPEDIENTES ***: petition, interrogatory, sworn witness depositions naming four
# generations, the priest's report, and sometimes a drawn schema. See data/corrections.tsv.
# All three were found by FULL-TEXT search on a bride's or a father's name, and all three were
# *** READ OFF THE PLATE ***, because the transcripts mangle the surname past recognition.
the document
*** 1855 - SOCORRO'S OWN MARRIAGE ***
column2: *** Arquidiocesis de Montevideo, Marriage Dispensation Records 1855-1857 ***, images 26-27, arks 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-23PJ-1 and 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-23PV-K. Petition of *** C. SERAPIO FERNANDEZ ***, Santisima Trinidad, *** August 1855 ***, decreed by Miguel Ramos; witness *** Don JOSE MARIA GUERRERO *** sworn on the 8th.
column3: *** AN EXPEDIENTE, NOT A LEDGER ENTRY *** - the class this archive believed it had not reached. He petitions to marry *** Dona SOCORRO LERENA ***, and the interrogatory asks the witnesses to name *** 'mis autores y demas ascendientes y a los de mi Esposa en pretencion'. ***

column1: *** AND THE WITNESS NAMES FOUR GENERATIONS ***
column2: conoce a *** Don SERAPIO FERNANDEZ *** y a sus Padres *** Don MANUEL y Dona MARIA DE LOS REYES GONZALEZ *** y a sus abuelos Don Juan [Ynz] y *** Dona BARBARA SOTURA ***, igualmente que conoce a la pretendida Esposa *** Dona SOCORRO LERENA *** y a sus Padres *** Don ALEJANDRO y Dona MARGARITA FERNANDEZ *** y a sus abuelos *** Don RAMON LERENA y Dona MARIA GONZALEZ ***
column3: *** SOCORRO LERENA'S PARENTS AND GRANDPARENTS, IN ONE SENTENCE. *** Father *** ALEJANDRO LERENA ***, mother *** MARGARITA FERNANDEZ ***; grandparents *** RAMON LERENA and MARIA GONZALEZ ***. *** THE REGISTER HAD NONE OF THESE PEOPLE IN THIS LINE. ***

column1: *** AND WHY THEY NEEDED DISPENSING ***
column2: saben y les consta que somos *** parientes en segundo grado de consanguinidad en linea transversal *** - read off the plate, not the transcript
column3: *** FIRST COUSINS. *** And the mechanism is in the surnames: his father is *** MANUEL FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ ***, her mother is *** MARGARITA FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ *** (the 1854 expediente gives both compounds in full). *** TWO FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ SIBLINGS, ONE MARRIED TO A LERENA. *** The degree is on the Fernandez side, not the Lerena side.

column1: *** AND SHE IS POOR, AND HER PARENTS ARE ALIVE ***
column2: la citada Dona Socorro Lerena es una *** pobre indotada *** que se halla *** al lado de sus Padres *** sin otra agencia que la triste labor de sus manos
column3: *** A DISPENSATION ARGUED ON POVERTY. *** The petition pleads that without the marriage she will struggle to find another husband, and that his daily visits have already risked her honour. *** IT ALSO DATES HER PARENTS: ALEJANDRO AND MARGARITA WERE ALIVE AT TRINIDAD IN AUGUST 1855. ***

column1: *** 1854 - HER BROTHER'S SECOND MARRIAGE ***
column2: *** Marriage Dispensation Records 1852-1855 ***, image 258, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-T9T9-T. Trinidad, *** 2 December 1854 ***; witness *** Don DAMASO PERERA ***: "conoce a *** Don ALEJANDRO LERENA de estado VIUDO de la finada Dona ISIDORA CHOURINO ***, igualmente a sus Padres *** Don ALEJANDRO y Dona MARGARITA FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ ***, del mismo modo conoce Don *** MANUEL FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ y Dona MARIA DE LOS REYES GONZALEZ, padres de la contrayenta ***"
column3: *** THERE ARE TWO ALEJANDRO LERENAS, FATHER AND SON *** - and this is the son, a widower remarrying *** Dona SEVERA FERNANDEZ ***. *** SO SEVERA AND SERAPIO ARE BROTHER AND SISTER ***, children of Manuel Fernandez Alvarez. *** TWO LERENA SIBLINGS MARRIED TWO FERNANDEZ SIBLINGS IN CONSECUTIVE YEARS ***, each pair dispensed - the same shape the 1911 Lerena-Cardozo diagram shows fifty-six years later.

column1: *** 1858 - BERNABE'S MARRIAGE, AND THE ANSWER ***
column2: *** Marriage Dispensation Records 1857-1860 ***, image 209, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-P3TS-W. Parroquia de la Santisima Trinidad, *** 15 February 1858 ***, reported by *** Luciano Bonamino, Cura Vicario ***, to the Provicario Apostolico Don Juan Domingo Fernandez: the expediente of *** Don BERNABE LERENA ***, who seeks dispensation to marry *** su parienta en SEGUNDO GRADO de consanguinidad en linea trasversal, Dona CASIMIRA PELAEZ ***.
column3: *** THE CONTRACTING PARTIES' PARENTS, ON THE PLATE: *** he is "*** hijo legitimo de Don ALEJANDRO LERENA y Dona MARGARITA FERNANDEZ, NATURALES DE SAN JOSE y vecinos de esta ***"; she is "*** hija legitima de Don JUAN PELAES y Dona ANTONINA LERENA, naturales de San Jose y vecinos de esta ***".

column1: *** AND THE PRIEST DREW THE FAMILY TREE ***
column2: A boxed schema on the folio, in the Cura Vicario's hand: *** RAMON LERENA / MARIA GONZALEZ *** at the apex, with two lines down to *** ALEJANDRO LERENA / MARGARITA FERNANDEZ *** on one side and *** ANTONINA LERENA / JUAN PELAES *** on the other, and below them *** BERNABE LERENA, contrayente *** and *** CASIMIRA PELAEZ, la contrayente ***
column3: *** THE SECOND KINSHIP DIAGRAM THIS ARCHIVE HAS FOUND, AND FIFTY-THREE YEARS OLDER THAN THE FIRST. *** It states, as a drawing rather than a sentence, that *** ALEJANDRO LERENA AND ANTONINA LERENA ARE BROTHER AND SISTER ***, children of *** RAMON LERENA AND MARIA GONZALEZ ***.

column1: *** WHICH ANSWERS WORK-LIST ROW 196 ***
column2: 1855: Socorro Lerena is a daughter of *** Alejandro Lerena and Margarita Fernandez ***. 1858: Bernabe Lerena is a son of *** Alejandro Lerena and Margarita Fernandez ***.
column3: *** SOCORRO AND BERNABE ARE BROTHER AND SISTER. *** Two expedientes, three years apart, one parish, the same parents written by two different clerks. *** THE ROW ASKED FOR THE LINK AND THE LINK IS NOW A DOCUMENT, NOT AN INFERENCE. *** And it closes the dispensation of *** 26 June 1885 ***: Serapio Fernandez the younger descends from Socorro, Antonina Lerena from Bernabe, *** so they are first cousins - exactly the SECOND GRADE by the EQUAL lateral line that the Archbishop lifted. ***

column1: *** AND IT GIVES THE KINDRED A HEAD ***
column2: *** RAMON LERENA and MARIA GONZALEZ ***, named as grandparents in 1855 and drawn at the apex in 1858; their children *** ALEJANDRO *** and *** ANTONINA ***, both *** naturales de SAN JOSE ***
column3: *** THE TRINIDAD KINDRED IS ONE FAMILY, NOT SIX OR SEVEN UNRELATED MEN. *** This register has carried that cluster since 13 September with the note that they were 'almost certainly brothers or first cousins'. *** THEY ARE, AND NOW IT IS WRITTEN DOWN BY A PRIEST WHO KNEW THEM. ***

column1: *** AND A CANDIDATE THIS ARCHIVE WILL NOT MERGE ***
column2: This register already holds *** RAMON LERENA of Rosario-Colla *** and *** MARIA JOSEFA GONZALEZ ***, named as the parents of *** MAURICIO LERENA *** on his marriage at *** SAN JOSE DE MAYO, 3 February 1837 ***
column3: *** THE SAME COUPLE'S NAMES AND THE SAME GENERATION. *** *** AND THE TEST THIS ROW SET WAS CARRIED OUT THE SAME DAY - IT CORRECTED THE ROW RATHER THAN CONFIRMING IT. *** The 1837 act was read off the plate (DGS 008143329, image 87) and says Mauricio was *** 'natural de la Villa del COLLA' ***, where the 1858 expediente calls the Trinidad Lerenas *** 'naturales de SAN JOSE' ***. *** DIFFERENT BIRTHPLACES, SO THE 'SHARED ORIGIN' THIS ROW CLAIMED IS WITHDRAWN *** - what is shared is only that Mauricio *** MARRIED *** at San Jose de Mayo while they were *** BORN *** there. *** WHAT REPLACED IT IS STRONGER AND OF A DIFFERENT KIND: TWO DESCENT LINES THAT CONVERGE. *** Bernabe of Trinidad is a grandson of a Ramon Lerena and Maria Gonzalez by the 1858 schema; *** CIPRIANO of Trinidad is now proved a son of Mauricio ***, who is a son of a Ramon Lerena and Maria Gonzalez by the 1837 act. *** TWO OF THE SIX OR SEVEN TRINIDAD MEN DESCEND FROM A COUPLE OF THAT NAME, BY TWO INDEPENDENT DOCUMENTS. *** *** STILL NOT MERGED: *** two couples can share two names, and nothing yet names Ramon's children together. *** THE TEST NOW: *** a baptism of Alejandro or Antonina at San Jose, or any record naming Ramon Lerena with more than one child.

column1: *** AND A FOURTH DOCUMENT THAT FITS WITHOUT BEING ASKED ***
column2: *** Flores. Death Records 1888-1917 ***, image 303, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-Q62K: the death at *** Cuchilla de Villas Boas *** of *** ANTONIO EUSEBIO PELAEZ ***, 20, son of *** Don MALBINO PELAEZ ***, 67, hacendado; "*** [abuelos] paternos, Don JUAN PELAEZ y Dona ANTONINA LERENA. Abuelos maternos: Don ALEJANDRO LERENA y Dona ISIDORA CHOURINO ***, todos orientales fallecidos"
column3: *** EVERY NAME IN IT IS NOW PLACED. *** Malvino Pelaez is a son of Juan Pelaez and Antonina Lerena - so a brother of Casimira and of Maria Pelaez - and he married a daughter of *** ALEJANDRO LERENA THE YOUNGER *** by his first wife. *** THAT IS WHY THE TWO ALEJANDRO PAIRINGS LOOKED LIKE A CONTRADICTION AND ARE NOT ONE: *** Margarita Fernandez is the elder's wife, Isidora Chourino the younger's. *** AND IT IS THE MALVINO PELAEZ WHO STOOD GODFATHER BESIDE EDUVIGES PELAEZ AT TRINIDAD ON 1 APRIL 1894. ***

column1: *** AND SOCORRO HERSELF, FORTY-SIX YEARS EARLIER ***
column2: *** Santisima Trinidad. Baptism Records 1848-1857 ***, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-F3H4-K, *** 25 January 1849 ***: godparents Don Manuel Ferreyra and *** Dona MARIA DEL SOCORRO LERENA ***, at the baptism of a child of Italian parents, by Fray Ramon Rivero at *** la Santisima Trinidad de los PORONGOS ***
column3: *** HER FULL NAME IS MARIA DEL SOCORRO ***, and she is already *** Dona *** and standing godmother in January 1849. On the age her grandson's 1897 birth act gives her, she is *** about seventeen *** - which corroborates the birth year of 1832 from a second direction, by a different clerk, forty-eight years earlier.

column1: *** THE S-FOR-L TRAP, AT ITS WORST AND ITS CLEAREST ***
column2: In the 1858 diagram the machine transcript reads *** 'Ramon SERENA' ***, *** 'Alejandro LORENA' ***, *** 'Antonina LORENA' *** and *** 'Bernabe LERESA' *** - and, in the prose four lines above, *** 'Antonina LERENA' *** correctly
column3: *** FIVE READINGS OF ONE SURNAME IN ONE FOLIO, IN ONE HAND. *** The plate shows every one of them is *** LERENA ***, written with the same looping capital. *** THE TRANSCRIBER'S OWN INCONSISTENCY IS AGAIN THE PROOF ***, and this is the strongest instance this archive holds: not two spellings of one name, but *** four manglings and one correct reading of a single word written five times on a single page. ***
